## Summary

Describe the user-facing outcome and the reason for the change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run check:web` (browser-core regression check, not macOS acceptance)
- [ ] `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high`
- [ ] Manual verification completed where behavior or appearance changed

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No real applicant data, recruiter email, tokens, credentials, or local exports are included
- [ ] New data or integration boundaries are documented
- [ ] Planned Windows/macOS downloads are not described as shipped; platform-specific claims have native test evidence
- [ ] Autofill changes preserve explicit site permission and the no-submit boundary

## Screenshots

Add before-and-after screenshots for visible changes, or write “Not applicable.”
